subject.title: Control UI: upload agent avatars from Agents tab

question: Should Control UI support persistent per-agent avatar uploads from the Agents tab, and if so should that use existing `agents.files.set` plus `agents.update` or a new dedicated admin upload RPC?
rationale: The missing capability is clear from source, but accepting browser-selected image bytes into an agent workspace and mutating `IDENTITY.md` needs maintainer intent for storage, auth scope, validation, and protocol surface.

options.title: Add bounded admin upload flow
options.body: Implement a persistent avatar upload with operator-admin authorization, strict image size/MIME checks, safe generated workspace-relative filenames, identity update semantics, and focused Control UI/Gateway tests.

options.title: Compose existing APIs
options.body: Avoid a new protocol method and make the UI write a validated avatar file through existing agent file APIs before updating the avatar identity string, if maintainers accept that product shape.

options.title: Keep local override only
options.body: Do not add workspace upload yet; retain the browser-local Quick Settings override and document manual `IDENTITY.md` or config paths until avatar rendering policy settles.

recommendation.title: Add bounded admin upload flow
recommendation.body: Implement a persistent avatar upload with operator-admin authorization, strict image size/MIME checks, safe generated workspace-relative filenames, identity update semantics, and focused Control UI/Gateway tests.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest combined history on agent avatar support, Control UI assistant identity, and the security boundary around avatar serving.
